root_cause_criterion.description: The fix adds the guard end > line before dereferencing *(end - 1). The vulnerable code unconditionally writes to end - 1 without checking that end > line, causing a 1-byte heap-buffer-overflow write when end == line (strlen returns 0 due to leading NUL byte).

nodes.description: After end = line + strlen(line), end == line because thisline[0] == 0x00 causes strlen to return 0.
At the sink *(end - 1) = 0, end == line, so end - 1 == thisline - 1, a 1-byte write to the left of the 2048-byte heap allocation.

edges.description: The pointer end computed at line 1882 (end == line due to strlen returning 0) propagates unchanged to the dereference at line 1909.
